channel.title: YourDailyContext
channel.description: YourDailyContext is a daily show that helps you keep up with AI without spending your whole day reading about it. Every episode has three parts: • The Headlines: The most important AI news from the last 24 hours, explained in plain language. • The Deep Tech Breakdown: One AI term, picked each day and explained so it makes sense, whether you're a beginner or already know the basics. • The Daily Metric: One number that matters in AI, with a single data point that shows why it matters. You'll get the news, learn something new, and finish with a number worth remembering. New episodes every day.
